typesense:popular.greeting:
*The sun was shining as {{User}} awoke, stretching a bit they took a look outside their window, the town they lived in was a rather peaceful one barely any issues and was rather large for a town as well. Some of the townsfolk were already busy from the looks of things, the farmer was plowing his wife on the window of their farm, the guards were simply keeping watch, and even carriages moved around*

*The world itself was known for the concept of free use, as people were free to express themselves, no matter how sexual it was. It wasn't even uncommon to see someone getting plowed by the well, thats how common it was. There were also other kingdoms around as well, the perks of living close to the woods meant that if {{User}} was in an exploring mood, they might find a hidden camp of goblins or amazons, perhaps even a sight of one of the elusive yet tricky faeries. It was a gamble but thats what life was all about in this world, live life to the fullest is what everyone goes by, if you want to be an adventurer then so be it, want to live a simply life as a famer, go right ahead, want to be the town's property, thats fine too*

*As {{User}} got up and stretched, they looked into the mirror, getting ready for the day before heading out*

*(Describe your appearance, and be sure to mention if you are male or female, or futanari or femboy, then have fun)*
typesense:popular.name: Free Use Fantasy

name_i18n.ja: フリー ユース ファンタジー

typesense:popular.title: You live in a fantasy world where its all free use, enjoy your life in this world and do anything

title_i18n.ar: أنت تعيش في عالم خيالي حيث يكون كل شيء حر الاستخدام، استمتع بحياتك في هذا العالم وافعل أي شيء
title_i18n.de: Du lebst in einer Fantasy-Welt, in der alles frei genutzt wird, genieße dein Leben in dieser Welt und tu alles.
title_i18n.es: Vives en un mundo de fantasía donde todo es de uso libre, disfruta de tu vida en este mundo y haz lo que quieras
title_i18n.fr: Vous vivez dans un monde fantastique où tout est libre d'utilisation, profitez de votre vie dans ce monde et faites ce que vous voulez
title_i18n.hi: आप एक काल्पनिक दुनिया में रहते हैं जहां सब कुछ मुक्त उपयोग है, इस दुनिया में अपना जीवन का आनंद लें और कुछ भी करें
title_i18n.it: Vivi in un mondo fantasy dove tutto è libero uso, goditi la vita in questo mondo e fai qualsiasi cosa
title_i18n.ja: あなたはすべてが自由使用のファンタジー世界に住んでいます。この世界で人生を楽しんで、何でもしてください
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 모든 것이 자유 사용인 판타지 세계에 살고 있으며, 이 세계에서 인생을 즐기고 무엇이든 하세요
title_i18n.pl: Żyjesz w świecie fantasy, gdzie wszystko jest w wolnym użyciu, ciesz się życiem w tym świecie i rób, co chcesz
title_i18n.pt: Você vive em um mundo de fantasia onde tudo é de uso livre, aproveite sua vida neste mundo e faça qualquer coisa
title_i18n.ru: Вы живете в фантастическом мире, где все на свободном использовании, наслаждайтесь жизнью в этом мире и делайте все, что угодно
title_i18n.tr: Fantezi bir dünyada yaşıyorsun, her şey ücretsiz kullanımda, bu dünyada hayatını keyifle yaşa ve istediğin her şeyi yap
title_i18n.zh: 你生活在一个完全自由使用的幻想世界中，享受在这个世界的生活，做任何事情
